parables.lesson: God rejoices when the lost return home.
parables.detail: A younger son wastes his inheritance and ends up feeding pigs.

parables.lesson: Love your neighbor, even the unexpected one.
parables.detail: A man falls among thieves on the road to Jericho.

parables.lesson: Small faith can grow into something great.
parables.detail: The least of all seeds grows into a tree where birds lodge.

parables.lesson: The condition of our hearts determines how God's word takes root.
parables.detail: Seed falls on the wayside, stony ground, among thorns, and good ground.

parables.lesson: God pursues the one who wanders, like a shepherd searching for a lost sheep.
parables.detail: A shepherd leaves the ninety and nine to search for one.

parables.lesson: Heaven rejoices over one sinner who is found, however small it may seem.
parables.detail: A woman lights a candle and sweeps the house for one piece of silver.

parables.lesson: God expects us to faithfully use what He has entrusted to us.
parables.detail: One servant buries his master's money in the earth.

parables.lesson: Stay ready and watchful, for we do not know the hour of Christ's return.
parables.detail: Five took no oil for their lamps while waiting for the bridegroom.

parables.lesson: Having been forgiven much, we must forgive others in turn.
parables.detail: A servant forgiven ten thousand talents chokes a man who owes him a hundred pence.

parables.lesson: Life does not consist in possessions; store up treasure with God instead.
parables.detail: A man plans to pull down his barns and build greater ones.

parables.parable: The Pharisee and the Tax Collector
parables.lesson: God exalts the humble and opposes the proud.
parables.detail: One man prays, 'God be merciful to me a sinner.'

parables.lesson: A life built on obedience to Christ's words withstands the storms of life.
parables.detail: One house stands on rock, the other falls on sand.

parables.lesson: God's grace is generous and not bound by human ideas of fairness.
parables.detail: Those hired at the eleventh hour receive a full day's penny.

parables.lesson: God's kingdom quietly spreads until it fills everything.
parables.detail: A woman hides it in three measures of meal until the whole is leavened.

parables.lesson: The kingdom is worth giving up everything to gain.
parables.detail: A man finds something buried in a field and sells all he has to buy the field.

parables.lesson: Nothing compares to the worth of God's kingdom.
parables.detail: A merchant sells all he has for one valuable find.

parables.lesson: At the end of the age, God will separate the righteous from the wicked.
parables.detail: Fishermen sort the good into vessels and cast the bad away.

parables.lesson: Good and evil grow together until God's final harvest.
parables.detail: An enemy sows weeds among the good seed while men sleep.

parables.lesson: God makes His kingdom grow in ways we cannot fully see.
parables.detail: A man sleeps and rises while the seed sprouts, first the blade, then the ear.

parables.lesson: Obedience matters more than words.
parables.detail: One son says 'I go, sir' but never goes to the vineyard.

parables.lesson: Rejecting God's Son brings judgment.
parables.detail: Tenants kill the landowner's son to seize his inheritance.

parables.lesson: Many are called, but few are chosen.
parables.detail: A guest is thrown out for not wearing a wedding garment.

parables.lesson: God's invitation is open to all, so do not make excuses.
parables.detail: Invited guests make excuses about land, oxen, and a new wife.

parables.lesson: Always pray and do not lose heart.
parables.detail: A woman keeps pleading with an unjust judge until he gives her justice.

parables.lesson: Be bold and persistent in prayer.
parables.detail: A man knocks at night asking to borrow three loaves.

parables.lesson: Our choices in this life have eternal consequences.
parables.detail: A beggar full of sores lies at a rich man's gate.

parables.lesson: Use worldly resources wisely with eternity in view.
parables.detail: A manager about to be fired reduces his master's debtors' bills.

parables.lesson: God is patient, but time to bear fruit is not unlimited.
parables.detail: The vinedresser asks for one more year to dig about it and dung it.

parables.lesson: Those forgiven much love much.
parables.detail: One owed five hundred pence, the other fifty, and both were forgiven.

parables.lesson: Be faithful with what God gives until He returns.
parables.detail: A nobleman travels to receive a kingdom and leaves money with ten servants.

parables.lesson: Serving those in need is serving Christ.
parables.detail: The King says, 'I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat.'

parables.lesson: Be faithful at all times, not only when the master is watching.
parables.detail: An evil servant says 'My lord delayeth his coming' and beats his fellow servants.

parables.lesson: Let your good works shine so others glorify God.
parables.detail: No one lights a candle and puts it under a bushel.

parables.lesson: The new life Christ brings cannot be squeezed into old forms.
parables.detail: Old wineskins burst when filled with new wine.

parables.lesson: Jesus has power to overcome Satan and free his captives.
parables.detail: No one can spoil a strong man's house unless he first binds him.

parables.lesson: Keep watch, for the Master may return at any hour.
parables.detail: A man going on a far journey commands the doorkeeper to watch.

parables.lesson: Whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
parables.detail: A guest is told 'Friend, go up higher' at a wedding.

parables.lesson: Following Jesus requires wholehearted commitment.
parables.detail: A builder sits down first to see if he can finish his tower.

parables.lesson: Serving God is our duty, not a reason for pride.
parables.detail: A servant comes in from plowing and still must serve his master's supper.

parables.lesson: Jesus lays down His life for His sheep.
parables.detail: A hireling flees when he sees the wolf coming.

parables.lesson: Remain in Christ to bear lasting fruit.
parables.detail: Branches that bear no fruit are taken away and burned.

parables.lesson: Watch for the signs that His return is near.
parables.detail: When its branch is tender and puts forth leaves, summer is nigh.

parables.lesson: A disciple shares both old and new truths from God's word.
parables.detail: A householder brings forth out of his treasure things new and old.

parables.lesson: Consider carefully what it costs to follow Jesus.
parables.detail: A ruler with ten thousand weighs meeting one coming with twenty thousand.

parables.lesson: Choose wise teachers and become like Christ.
parables.detail: Two men both fall into the ditch.
